premise: The PMO's status drift is not one vocabulary drifting — it is FIVE DIFFERENT AXES being read as one. Each artefact column below belongs to exactly one axis. Never map a value across axes without saying so.

lifecycle.note: 管控表 tab 1 carries no paused value — 鐵律 3 fixes it at four. The Main Tracker's 暫停 is therefore a project-level reading and never maps onto a 管控表 row. See rules.paused_is_project_level_only.

會議記錄 進度更新 · Done.note: 會議記錄's 進度更新 column offers On track／At risk／Delayed／Done in one list, but Done is not a health reading — it is the lifecycle value. Resolve it to lifecycle `done` and read health for that row as `on_track` only if the derivation says so. Recorded here explicitly so no reader silently folds a lifecycle value into the health axis.

derivation.at_risk: (End <= today+3 AND lifecycle = not_started) OR an open blocker older than 7 days
derivation.note: health is always computed from lifecycle plus dates plus open blockers. It is never typed by a human and never written back to a Status column. See rules.health_never_written_to_status.

risk.note: A 阻礙 that survives one week must be escalated into a Risk Register row with Owner and 狀態 filled (會議記錄 header rule).

decision.note: A 決議 touching 範疇／時程／預算 must be synced here, and every Drop on tab 1 must leave a row here.

closure.note: Closure is a verdict on the project, taken once. 管控表 reaching 100% or the project being stopped is the trigger; the project is not finished until 復盤 is written and 封存 is filed (鐵律 5).

health_meeting.surface: 會議記錄 進度更新

risk.surface: 管控表 Risk Register 狀態

decision.surface: 管控表 Change & Decision Log 狀態

取消.reason: not in any surface vocabulary on any axis — the 管控表 word for this is `Drop`, the Main Tracker word is `放棄`
取消.handling: data error, not a fifth bucket: the row STAYS in the % denominator, never counts as done, is never folded into a legal bucket, and is named in data_errors with its no. and the offending literal. See rules.illegal_status_literal.
取消.history: project-status-update silently folded 取消 into `Not started`. The arithmetic happened to land in the right place — an unclassifiable row does belong in the denominator — but the silence did not: nobody reading the report knew a row was unreadable. The fix is the naming, not a change of bucket.

暫停.reason: project-level only — 管控表 tab 1 has no paused value because 鐵律 3 fixes it at four (Done / WIP / Not started / Drop)
did_you_mean: WIP + a Note explaining the pause
Drop + a Change & Decision Log entry
暫停.handling: on 管控表 tab 1 it is a data error and is handled exactly like 取消 — stays in the denominator, outside done, named in data_errors. On Main Tracker 專案項目 it is a legal PROJECT-level lifecycle value and no error at all.

rules.paused_is_project_level_only_note: 管控表 tab 1 has no paused value (鐵律 3 fixes four values). A paused TASK is recorded as `WIP` plus a Note, or as `Drop` with a Change & Decision Log entry. The Main Tracker's 暫停 therefore maps to a project, never to a 管控表 row.

percent_complete.total: every task row in scope, INCLUDING rows whose Status literal is illegal
percent_complete.was: two bugs at once — real `Drop` rows were left in the denominator (inflating it), and the illegal literal 取消 was silently folded into `Not started` instead of being named
percent_complete.reporting: dropped rows are listed separately in the report, never silently discarded; a non-empty data_errors list makes the percent provisional and the summary must say so

empty_denominator.when: counted(s) - dropped(s) = 0 for a stage — the stage has no task rows at all, or every row is Drop
empty_denominator.do: remove that stage from the spine for the percent maths (total_spine_stages drops by 1) and name it in data_errors
empty_denominator.why: 0% would let a stage that was entirely cancelled drag the whole report down forever

illegal_status_literal.definition: a 管控表 tab 1 Status value outside the four legal literals Done / WIP / Not started / Drop (鐵律 3)
illegal_status_literal.is: a data error, not a fifth bucket
illegal_status_literal.reported_as: a data_errors entry naming the row's no. and the offending literal
illegal_status_literal.why: a row you cannot classify is work you cannot claim is finished — taking it out of the denominator flatters the number, which is the same class of bug as the dropped-counted-as-not_started fold this change exists to fix. Only `dropped` leaves the denominator.

rules.meeting_done_is_lifecycle_note: 會議記錄's 進度更新 column lists On track／At risk／Delayed／Done in one list, but Done is the lifecycle value, not a health reading. Resolve it to lifecycle `done`; that row's health is still derived from dates × lifecycle. Full record in axes.health.cross_axis; mirrored in pm-knowledge-pack.md §2.
rules.health_never_written_to_status_note: 會議記錄's On track／At risk／Delayed is a health reading, not a lifecycle status. It must never be written back into 管控表 `Status`, and 管控表 `Status` must never be surfaced as a RAG colour without running the derivation. Mirrors pm-knowledge-pack.md §2.2 裁決三.

not_in_this_file.delivery_spine: adapter DATA — ~/.config/zynkr/pm.json → projects.<slug>.spine, an ordered array of stage names. project-init seeds the five delivery phases 啟動 · 規劃 · 執行 · 監控 · 結案 as X.0 rows; a skill that cannot read it falls back to those five and prints a warning. 跨階段 Cross-Cutting is a PARALLEL TRACK, never a spine stage and never in the denominator.
not_in_this_file.report_recipients: adapter DATA — ~/.config/zynkr/pm.json → projects.<slug>.report_recipients. No recipient literal belongs in any SKILL.md; a missing key fails loud.
